Champions.action: Reward them: VIP / loyalty perks, early access to new ranges, ask for reviews and referrals. Don't waste discounts here.
Champions.description: Bought recently, buy often and spend the most.

Loyal.action: Upsell and cross-sell with 'also bought' bundles, tiered loyalty points, free-shipping thresholds just above their usual basket.
Loyal.description: Regular, recent buyers with solid spend — the next Champions.

New \/ Promising.action: Onboarding flow: welcome series, best-seller recommendations, a time-limited second-order incentive to build the habit.
New \/ Promising.description: Bought recently but only once or twice, small baskets so far.

top_products: SET OF 3 CAKE TINS PANTRY DESIGN
At Risk.action: Win-back campaign now: personalised 'we miss you' email with their favourite categories and a moderate discount. Highest ROI for reactivation spend.
At Risk.description: Used to buy fairly regularly but haven't been back for a couple of months.

Lost.action: Low-cost channels only: occasional newsletter or big seasonal sale. Don't spend paid-media budget here.
Lost.description: One-off, low-spend buyers who haven't purchased in ~6+ months.
